title: The Supreme Court's 2026 Order on Unpaid Domestic Labour
description: Subject: Role of Women and Women’s Organization Context: In a landmark judicial shift, the Supreme Court of India delivered an order recognizing homemakers as nation builders and economic entities rather than merely passive caregivers. About The Supreme Court’s 2026 Order on Unpaid Domestic Labour: Key Data and Statistics on Domestic Caregiving: The Imperative Need to Value Unpaid Domestic Labour: The Newly Mandated Compensation Mechanism: The Supreme Court established a strict, uniform framework to calculate the Loss of Domestic Care head: The Supreme Court’s 2026 judgment marks a major step forward for economic and social justice by recognizing the true financial value of unpaid domestic labor. By framing homemakers as nation builders and establishing a fixed ₹30,000 monthly baseline for domestic care, the law has moved past treating women’s work as a matter of minor charity or emotional sentiment. Domestic drudgery has severe consequences on the women. Analyse the reasons behind it and suggest measures to reduce the domestic drudgery faced by women. (250 words)

title: India Can Save Its Forests By Winning The War On Poverty
description: Context: A breakthrough international study published in the journal Nature Sustainability has challenged the traditional fortress conservation model by establishing a direct link between poverty alleviation and forest biodiversity. About India Can Save Its Forests By Winning The War On Poverty: Key Trends and Findings Over the Last Decade: Positive Indicators: Community-Led Conservation Successes: The findings of the Nature Sustainability study demonstrate that the war on poverty and the fight for biodiversity conservation are two sides of the same coin. Relying on rigid, exclusionary fortress models is no longer sustainable in a human-dominated landscape where 275 million people depend on forest resources. “The global forest crisis is as much a governance challenge as it is an environmental challenge.” Analyse the structural causes behind continued forest degradation. Examine the limitations of existing global forest governance frameworks. (15 M)

title: Schedule K of the Drugs Rules, 1945
description: Context: The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has notified a crucial amendment to the Drugs Rules, 1945, explicitly withdrawing the licensing exemption previously granted for selling cough syrups in small villages.
